name: Algebraic Inequality Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit boolean logic and De Morgan phrasing of a 2-SAT clause with an equivalent arithmetic inequality over transformed variables. By mapping boolean states to {-1, 1} and defining an interaction sum that must be non-negative, models must recognize that the condition algebraically prevents both terms from being -1 simultaneously, thereby reconstructing the 2-SAT clause structure from first principles rather than pattern-matching DIMACS boilerplate.
